_note: M-LOADOUT PerkCatalog (docs/spec/loadout.md §1.2, docs/perk-design.md). A perk is the third slot of a player's kit (A14, 2026-09-04: beside the weapons; the ALT-button accessibility switch moved OUT of this slot in S50 -- see `easy_reload` below). v1 perks are PASSIVE: pure head-frame tweaks the compiler already knows how to write ($PSET armor/shield, $AMMO + $WEAP ammo/reload tokens, a $SIR key swap) or, for `motion_tracker`/`second_wind`, entirely NODE-LOCAL (the phone's own logic against its own gun; `effects: {}` on purpose -- do not invent a wire lever for either). `mechanism: slot_frame` rows would be a $WEAP in slot 1 whose effect lives in the VICTIM's $SIR table (game-wide, not per-player) — they stay `hidden` until the emit-side bench proves them. `verified` = effect proven on hardware. Copy is player-facing: no protocol jargon. S50 (2026-09-17, perk balance pass, decided in docs/perk-design.md §2): S50 priced each perk against another perk's benefit. Fast Hands replaces the two handling perks without a cost (2026-10-25). `effects.max_armor_add` is a FLAT armour grant/cost, this field is the one source of the number (`compile.py` builds `_MAX_ARMOR_ADD` from it and runs the arithmetic; F604), kept a plain integer because `app/src/hud/hud.js` and `webapp/mc/src/screens/Kit.tsx` both render it literally as '+N ARMOR'. body_armor is +20 (after +25 in S50, reduced on 2026-10-25; it was a flat +50 before S50); Fast Hands merges Quick Hands and Quick Switch with half reload and swap time, unchanged ammunition and no armour cost. The Shields preset refuses body_armor (A80, `Compiler.preset_block`): the preset has no armour to add to. `hidden` (2026-09-18): `motion_tracker` and `second_wind` are the two NODE-LOCAL perks of the S50 set (docs/perk-design.md §2). The compiler has nothing to write for either, and the phone half is not built, so they are hidden until it is. A visible perk that does nothing is worse than a missing one: a player picks it, gets nothing, and reports a bug in something else. `effects.ammo_mult_pistol` (D5, 2026-09-25, docs/perk-design.md §2): extended_mags' per-class override -- a pistol primary (role `sidearm` or the `pistol` tag) takes this value instead of `ammo_mult`, rounded DOWN (`compile.py` `WeaponCatalog._ammo` is the one place either multiplier is read, so the compiled frame and the phone's own $AMMO report can never disagree). Every other weapon keeps the plain `ammo_mult`. `emp` (2026-10-24, Tony via brx1: the EMP perk in place of the Haze weapon): the holder's phone throws a host `$IRTX` on cell <8,1> on LEFT, and every gun in a match with a holder carries a fn-23 row there (`compile.py` `_EMP_SIR_ROW`). `effects.cooldown_s` (45) and `effects.stun_duration_s` (6) are PLACEHOLDERS until brx2's pass-2 numbers. The victim's phone holds the jam for max(stun_duration_s, SMOKE_MS = 6 s), because fn 23 leaves the gun's accuracy at 0 for about 6 s whatever the phone does. UNHIDE when docs/bench-0426.md P2.5-P2.11 pass and Tony sets the numbers.

perks.name: Body Armor
perks.desc: Start every life with 20 extra armour, about a sixth more total health in Standard. Armour soaks hits before your health does. The rig is heavier though: your reload takes a quarter longer (not the Sniper Rifle's bolt).

perks.name: Extended Mags
perks.desc: In Standard, double the magazine on your primary. In Shields, increase it by 50%. Your reserve grows up to 384 rounds; some rifles already reach that limit. A pistol primary gains 50%, rounded down. The Sniper Rifle is exempt: its bolt keeps one round. The larger magazine slows your weapon swap by 30%.

perks.name: Fast Hands
perks.desc: Reload and swap weapons in half the time. The Sniper Rifle's bolt keeps its normal speed.

perks.name: Armor Piercing
perks.desc: Your primary ignores armor and shields and goes straight to health. The rounds are heavier: fewer of them, and the gun cycles slower. Against a bare target a normal weapon still kills faster, and against an armored or shielded one this wins. It fits any plain-damage primary; the host is told if the chosen weapon cannot carry it.

perks.name: Motion Tracker
perks.desc: Nearby enemies show on your HUD, no direction, refreshed every few seconds. You carry information instead of firepower -- anyone who accepts being seen can still shoot first.

perks.name: Second Wind
perks.desc: Once a life, the hit that would finish you leaves you standing instead. It costs nothing up front, because it only pays when you are already losing -- and a weapon that kills in one hit goes through it anyway.

perks.name: Med Kit
perks.desc: A healing shot for teammates — tag an ally to top up their health.

perks.name: Concussion
perks.desc: A stun burst that jams an enemy's weapon for a few seconds.

perks.name: EMP
perks.desc: Press LEFT to throw a pulse that jams every enemy gun around you for a few seconds. They can still swing a melee, but no shot fires. It recharges on the match clock, so dying does not reset it.
